description: This is a Java test class for the ThingsRoute component, containing unit tests for various HTTP endpoints related to 'things'. It uses Akka HTTP testkit and JUnit, and interacts with classes like ThingsRoute, EndpointTestBase, and others to verify behavior of REST API endpoints.

classes.name: ThingsRouteTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the ThingsRoute class, testing various HTTP API endpoints related to 'things' in the system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the ActorSystem, ProtocolAdapterProvider, ThingsRoute, and TestRoute.

methods.name: putNewThingWithAttributesSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that a PUT request to create a new 'thing' with attributes succeeds with HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: postFeaturesReturnsMethodNotAllowed
methods.description: Tests that POST method to /things/{id}/features returns HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed.

methods.name: createThingWithInvalidInitialPolicy
methods.description: Tests that invalid initial policy data results in HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: createThingWithInvalidInitialDefinition
methods.description: Tests that invalid initial definition data results in HTTP 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: putPolicyIdAssumesJsonContentType
methods.description: Tests that PUTting a policyId with non-JSON content results in an 'json.invalid' error; verifying behavior with correct JSON.

methods.name: putDefinitionAssumesJsonContentType
methods.description: Tests that PUTting a definition with non-JSON content results in an 'json.invalid' error; verifying behavior with correct JSON.

methods.name: putAndRetrieveNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests PUT with 'null' as definition to clear it, followed by GET to verify the retrieval.

methods.name: getThingsWithEmptyIdsList
methods.description: Tests GET /things with empty 'ids=' parameter, expecting a BAD_REQUEST due to missing IDs.

methods.name: getAttributesWithTrailingSlash
methods.description: Tests fetching attributes endpoint with a trailing slash, expecting OK and containing RetrieveAttributes.TYPE.

methods.name: getAttributesWithoutSlashButRandomText
methods.description: Tests GET /things/{id}/attributes with random text, expecting NOT_FOUND.

methods.name: putAttributeWithEmptyPointer
methods.description: Tests PUT attributes with an empty pointer segment, expecting BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: putAttributeWithJsonException
methods.description: Tests PUT attribute with a large number that may break JSON parsing, expecting BAD_REQUEST.

methods.name: putAttributeWithJsonPointerException
methods.description: Tests PUT attribute with a JSON object containing an invalid pointer syntax, expecting BAD_REQUEST.
